title: Disposition the seven bootstrap source-negative observations under bounded authority
description:
Revisit the seven exact bootstrap rows that motivated prove-clause-complete-absence.
For each, identify the actual bounded claim and current owner: source-fidelity repair,
bounded capability, DM adjudication/discovery support, state integrity, or a genuinely
provable negative over an explicitly enumerated bounded property. Missing markers or
empty projection cannot establish source-mechanic absence.
acceptance_criteria:
- Each of the seven known rows has an explicit ADR-0020 disposition and replacement responsibility.
- Any retained negative claim names the exact bounded property/population and independent evidence making absence provable.
- Missing/unrecognized projection never becomes no-mechanic evidence.
- Model-adjudicated rows remain discoverable source material; capability rows use bounded source-obligation/capability contracts.
- No result establishes corpus-wide clause completeness.
notes:
Created as a follow-up from eshyra-o9bd.19.5.1.7. Current implementation deliberately leaves these seven blockers underived and fail-closed; do not tune the ledger to a target count.
ADR-0020 authority reconciliation applied 2026-09-10 by eshyra-o9bd.19.6.5.
The operative title/description/acceptance criteria supersede contradictory
pre-ADR global-closure language in older notes. Historical notes remain evidence,
not current authority.
